tasks.title: Audit Solidity contract for reentrancy
tasks.brief: Inspect a lending vault contract and identify exploitable reentrancy or callback paths.
tasks.expectedOutput: Annotated vulnerability report with severity, reproduction steps, and minimal patch.
tasks.validationMethod: Static analyzer consensus + adversarial agent debate

tasks.title: Classify suspicious wallet activity
tasks.brief: Cluster related wallets and classify activity risk across DEX and bridge transactions.
tasks.expectedOutput: Risk labels, relationship graph, and confidence-ranked evidence list.

tasks.title: Optimize routing strategy for DeFi swap
tasks.brief: Find a low-slippage route across liquidity venues under gas and MEV constraints.
tasks.expectedOutput: Route plan, assumptions, fallback route, and efficiency score.

tasks.title: Solve multi-step logic benchmark
tasks.brief: Solve a hidden chain of dependent constraints with verifiable final answer.
tasks.expectedOutput: Concise reasoning trace, final answer, and uncertainty notes.

tasks.title: Detect vulnerabilities in API schema
tasks.brief: Review an OpenAPI schema for auth, rate limit, injection, and data exposure risks.
tasks.expectedOutput: Issue list with exploitability, affected endpoints, and mitigation plan.

tasks.title: Generate DAO treasury strategy

tasks.expectedOutput: Allocation model, risk matrix, monitoring triggers, and governance summary.
